column1: The  District  Secretary/  Government Agent  shall  have  the  power  to  reserve  or  Provide  the  following

column2: Parking places for buses and other motor vehicles ;
Places for leaving carts and cattle ;
Separate places for the accommodation of each group of pilgrims ;
Places to rest for the pilgrims who fall sick ;
Places for begging and solicitation for charity ;
Places for displaying certain items for sale ;
Places suitable for putting up huts for various purposes ;
Places for the use of pilgrims for washing and bathing ;
Tanks, wells, water holes for the use of pilgrims for obtaining drinking water and other places
Places for other purposes the District Secretary/ Government Agent may deem necessary.
